cinematic.grid_editor.depth.tooltip: Change the grid's depth and the distance between its rows.
cinematic.grid_editor.height.tooltip: Raise or lower the working surface for a resource pack's model. Hands and click targets follow it.
cinematic.grid_editor.item_size.tooltip: Scale tabletop ingredients and recipe ghosts. This does not change actual stacks.
cinematic.grid_editor.hint: Drag the grid · Enter — save · Esc — cancel

cinematic.settings.title: Cinematic Interactions — Settings
cinematic.settings.scenes.note: Which blocks greet you with a scene, and what happens when a block is out of reach.
cinematic.settings.blocks.tooltip: A block switched off opens its usual window, as in vanilla.
cinematic.settings.interface.note: The text over the scene and the world.
cinematic.settings.camera.note: The pace of a scene and how the camera comes up to the block. Below, the effects: if camera motion makes you queasy, turn off what you don't need.
cinematic.settings.multiplayer.note: On servers without the mod, client-only mode shows scenes over vanilla menus. The server still handles items and recipes. The choice takes effect on your next connection.
cinematic.settings.clientOnlyMode.locked: Change client-only mode from the main menu. The new choice takes effect after reconnecting.
cinematic.configuration.title: Cinematic Interactions — Settings
cinematic.configuration.multiplayer.tool: How stations appear on servers without Cinematic Interactions.
cinematic.configuration.clientOnlyMode.t: On: supported stations show local scenes over real Minecraft menus on servers without the mod. Off: vanilla screens open. Servers with the mod always use the full mode. Change this from the main menu; it takes effect on your next connection.
cinematic.configuration.scenes.tooltip: Which blocks greet you with a scene, and what happens when a block is out of reach.
cinematic.configuration.heightLogic.tool:
When a block's work can't be reached from where you stand (too high, too low, too far, something lying on it or in the way):
§aOn§r — the block's usual window opens instead of the scene.
§6Off§r — no window opens; a short line above the hotbar says why: "Too high", "In the way: Stone Slab"…
The usual window always opens with Shift + right-click with an empty hand.
cinematic.configuration.blocks.tooltip: A block switched off opens its usual window, as in vanilla.
cinematic.configuration.table.tooltip: Items are laid out right on the 3×3 top and crafted by hand.
cinematic.configuration.furnace.tooltip: Fuel goes into the lower opening, what to smelt into the upper one; results are taken out by hand.
cinematic.configuration.smoker.tooltip: Food goes into the window, fuel behind the grate below it.
cinematic.configuration.blast_furnace.to: Ore is charged from the top, fuel goes behind the grate, ingots come out on the sill.
cinematic.configuration.enchanting.toolt: The item floats over the book, lapis rests in a socket, the offers hang in the air as runes.
cinematic.configuration.anvil.tooltip: The item lies on the anvil; a hammer forges it with what lies on top.
cinematic.configuration.grindstone.toolt: The item is held to the wheel; its enchantments flake away in sparks.
cinematic.configuration.smithing.tooltip: Template and material are laid on the gear, heat up and fuse into one thing.
cinematic.configuration.stonecutter.tool: Stone is laid by the saw; the shapes it can be cut into hang around the blade.
cinematic.configuration.loom.tooltip: The banner is stretched over the warp, the patterns hang beside it, a shuttle weaves.
cinematic.configuration.cartography.tool: The map lies on the table; paper, glass or an empty map beside it.
cinematic.configuration.brewing.tooltip: Bottles go on the feet, the ingredient into the bowl, blaze powder by the foot.
cinematic.configuration.crafter.tooltip: Items are laid into the window of its grid; it crafts on a redstone signal, as in vanilla.
cinematic.configuration.campfire.tooltip: The "sit by the fire" scene on the H key, at campfires and soul campfires. Food can be put on the fire without it.
cinematic.configuration.lectern.tooltip: The book on the lectern is read right in the world, its leaves turned by the corner.
cinematic.configuration.beacon.tooltip: The powers hang in a crown over the beacon; the payment is laid on top.
cinematic.configuration.interface.toolti: The text over the scene and the world.
cinematic.configuration.controlHints.too: The line at the bottom of the screen during a scene: "LMB — take / put · Esc — step away" and so on.
cinematic.configuration.campfireInvite.t: The "[H] Sit by the fire" plate under the crosshair when looking at a campfire. The key works without it too.
cinematic.configuration.camera.tooltip: The pace of a scene, the camera's lean and the effects.
cinematic.configuration.letterbox.toolti: Black bars at the top and bottom while the camera moves up to the block and back.
cinematic.configuration.livingCamera.too: The camera breathes slightly and drifts a little after the cursor while you work.
cinematic.configuration.cameraShake.tool: A hammer blow, a spell, the beacon lighting up: the camera trembles and leans in for a moment.
cinematic.configuration.screenFlash.tool: The screen flashes with the light of a spell and with white-hot metal.
cinematic.notice.wrong_side: Come round to its working side
cinematic.settings.effects.tooltip: The scenes themselves stay the same.
cinematic.configuration.approachSpeed.to:
How fast the camera leans in to the block once you have stepped up to it.
100% — as made (1.2 s), 200% — twice as fast, 50% — half as fast.
cinematic.configuration.leaveSpeed.toolt:
How fast you step away from the block and the camera comes back to your eyes.
100% — as made (about a second).
cinematic.configuration.leanStrength.too:
How far the camera leans in from your eyes towards the block.
100% — all the way, as made; 0% — the camera stays at your eyes and only looks at the work.
cinematic.configuration.sceneZoom.toolti:
How much the view narrows in a scene.
100% — as made; 0% — your own field of view from the game settings stays.
cinematic.recipes.lay_out_tip: Take the materials from the inventory and lay them out on the table for the recipe
cinematic.recipes.nothing_to_lay_tip: Nothing to lay out: it is all there, or the inventory has none of it
cinematic.look.hold: Let go of %s — back to work · wheel — nearer / further
cinematic.look.toggle: %s — back to work · wheel — nearer / further
cinematic.configuration.lookToggles.tool:
While at work, a key (Left Alt, rebindable in the controls) takes the camera behind you: you see yourself at work, look round with the mouse, come nearer or go further with the wheel.
Held — while the key is down; pressed — once to look round, again to come back.
cinematic.configuration.jukebox.tooltip: A short scene: the record in hand stands on its edge over the slot and is lowered into it, and the music plays; a playing record rises out and the hand takes it.
cinematic.jukebox.hint.take: LMB on the jukebox — take the record out · Esc — step away
cinematic.jukebox.hint.put: LMB on the jukebox — put the record in · Esc — step away
cinematic.jukebox.hint.choose: Take a record from the panel at the top and click the jukebox · Esc — step away
cinematic.jukebox.empty: Take a record from the panel at the top
cinematic.configuration.quickReturn.tool: Coming back to the same station soon after stepping away, the way in is short: a quick lean, no bars. The first time is as usual.
cinematic.configuration.quickWindow.tool: For how many seconds after stepping away from a station going back to it is quick. Every quick return starts the count again.
cinematic.configuration.chiseled_bookshe: Crouch at the shelf: the book under the cursor slides out a little and shows what it is (an enchanted book its enchantments), a click draws it out by its spine. A book with writing in it can be opened and read right at the shelf.
cinematic.shelf.empty: An empty place: take a book from the panel at the top
cinematic.shelf.hint: LMB on a book — take it, a book with writing — read it  ·  Shift+LMB — into the inventory  ·  Esc — step away
cinematic.shelf.hint.put: LMB on an empty place — put the book in  ·  Esc — step away
cinematic.shelf.hint.read: Click the right page — forward, the left — back  ·  the wheel and arrow keys turn pages too  ·  RMB or Esc — back on the shelf  ·  Shift+click — take it
cinematic.configuration.developerMode.to: Shows the editor gear at every station and enables G. Disabling it cancels unsaved drafts. Saved layouts continue to apply.
cinematic.settings.developer.note: Align workstations with your resource pack: enable this mode, then press G or the gear in a scene. Saved layouts always apply.
cinematic.furnace_editor.title: Working areas
cinematic.furnace_editor.offset_u.toolti: Move left / right on the working face. One unit is a vanilla texture pixel (1/16 of a block). Items and click targets move together.
cinematic.furnace_editor.offset_v.toolti: On the front: up / down. On the top: towards the back / front edge. Drag a highlighted area to move it directly.
cinematic.furnace_editor.width.tooltip: Scale the highlight width and the spacing between items. Click targets scale with the area.
cinematic.furnace_editor.height.tooltip: On the front: area height. On the top: area depth from front to back. Highlight bounds stay on the block.
cinematic.furnace_editor.out.tooltip: Move the contact plane: positive is out from the front or up from the top, negative is inside. Hands and click targets follow it.
cinematic.furnace_editor.item_size.toolt: Scale items inside the furnace and the editor preview items. Actual stacks and counts stay the same.
cinematic.furnace_editor.click_width.too: Extra horizontal click target size without moving the highlight or items. Useful for a small opening.
cinematic.furnace_editor.click_height.to: Extra click target height on the front or depth on the top. Avoid overlapping click targets.
cinematic.furnace_editor.item_u.tooltip: Move only the items left / right inside the area. Highlights and click targets stay in place.
cinematic.furnace_editor.item_v.tooltip: Move only the items up / down on the front or along the top. The rest of the area stays in place.
cinematic.surface_editor.title: Work areas
cinematic.surface_editor.offset_x.toolti: Moves the spot, item and hand contact left / right relative to the working side. One pixel is 1/16 of a block.
cinematic.surface_editor.offset_z.toolti: Moves the spot away from / towards the player. The work area stays on the tabletop.
cinematic.surface_editor.rotation.toolti: Rotates the item and click area. The work animation follows the edited placement.
cinematic.surface_editor.width.tooltip: Width of the frame and click area. Item size is adjusted separately.
cinematic.surface_editor.depth.tooltip: Depth of the frame and click area. Item size is adjusted separately.
cinematic.surface_editor.height.tooltip: Height of the item and contact plane above the tabletop: −2 to +2 pixels.
cinematic.surface_editor.item_size.toolt: Size of the item on the table and during the work animation. For cartography, the map or addition itself.
cinematic.surface_editor.drag_hint: Drag a spot · scroll to fine-tune
cinematic.surface_editor.hint: Drag a spot · Enter — save · Esc — cancel
cinematic.spatial_editor.offset_x.toolti: Moves left / right on the face. At the brewing stand, moves along world X. In Whole layout mode all slots move together.
cinematic.spatial_editor.offset_y.toolti: On a vertical face, moves up / down. On the crafter top, moves away from / towards the player. Drag a framed spot to move it directly.
cinematic.spatial_editor.offset_z.toolti: Moves along world Z. Bottle positions stay anchored to the stand when viewed from another side.
cinematic.spatial_editor.rotation.toolti: Rotates the selected item and its click area. Whole layout also rotates the arrangement of all slots.
cinematic.spatial_editor.width.tooltip: Width of the click area. Whole layout also changes the spacing between columns; item size has its own slider.
cinematic.spatial_editor.depth.tooltip: Depth of the click area. Whole layout also changes spacing along this axis.
cinematic.spatial_editor.area_height.too: Height of the click area on a front face, or depth on the crafter top. Whole layout changes row spacing too.
cinematic.spatial_editor.height.tooltip: Raises / lowers the item and hand contact by up to two pixels. Bottle size grows from its foot.
cinematic.spatial_editor.outward.tooltip: Moves items and hand contacts away from the working face. Books stay in front of its texture; the crafter top moves vertically.
cinematic.spatial_editor.item_size.toolt: Scales the displayed item or book and its motion. Whole layout multiplies the size of all items. The stored items are unchanged.
cinematic.spatial_editor.drag_hint: Drag a spot · scroll to fine-tune
cinematic.spatial_editor.towards.tooltip: Moves along the tabletop away from / towards the player. Dragging a floating target vertically also changes its height.
cinematic.spatial_editor.along_book.tool: Moves the book up or down the lectern slope.
cinematic.settings.profiles.note: Choose each station’s saved profile; edit it in the scene. Both campfires share profiles.
cinematic.settings.profiles.tooltip: Selects one of this station’s three saved layouts. Items and other profiles are unchanged. The selected layout also applies with developer mode off.
